name: Full Propagator Approximation for Multiply-Scattered Radiance
definition: The full approximate expression for the multiply-scattered propagator G_s is obtained by multiplying the contribution of each path by its probability and summing over all paths (expected value of standard single path attenuation over the pdf of paths).
summary: The Full Propagator Approximation computes multiply-scattered radiance by integrating over a Gaussian support perpendicular to the Most Probable Path, offering a faster alternative to full path tracing.
